reason: Candidate B’s emphasis on the glide‐to‐twinning transition under high strain rates and low temperatures aligns well with established TWIP‐type mechanisms in Fe‐Mn‐based alloys and provides a clear, testable framework for as‐solidified FeNiCrMn. Its proposed experiment is well targeted to verify (or falsify) that twinning is the primary driver of the dynamic response over relevant strain‐rate and temperature regimes.
